exposure: chemotherapy with taxanes plus platinum-based agents
Treatment received (e.g. taxanes plus platinum-based chemotherapy)
cohort: 204 pregnant women with cancer from 7 Chinese tertiary A hospitals
finding: Over time, pregnancy termination rates for cancer declined while pre-delivery treatment rates increased, with taxane plus platinum-based chemotherapy associated with adverse obstetric outcomes and cancer type influencing both obstetric and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that ovarian cancer was associated with fewer cesarean sections compared to other pregnancy-associated cancers.
